title: Some opposition groups plotting to destabilise country, create turmoil: President
byline: Claiming that certain opposition politicians are plotting to destabilise the government and create turmoil in the country, President Anura Kumara Dissanayake said yesterday such ploys will be unsuccessful as the stability of the government is relying on people’s trust.

title: Govt. moves to tighten foreign travel rules for monks
byline: The government is moving to strictly enforce and update regulations governing the foreign travel of Buddhist monks, aiming to restore order and address serious misconduct within the clergy.

title: Trump says he’s dissatisfied with Iranian proposal as rift with allies deepens
byline: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Friday he was not satisfied with the latest Iranian proposal for ​talks on the Iran war, while Iran’s foreign minister said Tehran was ready for diplomacy if the United States changes its approach.

title: Pakistan PM dials Iranian President, discusses evolving regional situation
byline: Pakistan Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif spoke with Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian and discussed the evolving regional situation.

title: Bus collision in Naula leaves 11 injured
byline: A serious road accident occurred this morning (26) in the Naula–Nalanda area along the Dambulla–Matale main road, involving a private bus and a Sri Lanka Transport Board (SLTB) bus.

title: Ranil thanks well wishers
byline: Former President Ranil Wickremesinghe today expressed his gratitude to all who wished him during his surgery.

title: MP Archchuna allegedly involved in armed confrontation over land dispute
byline: Controversial Jaffna District Member of Parliament, Ramanathan Archchuna, was allegedly involved in a heated confrontation on Saturday (April 25), during which he was seen brandishing a firearm while arguing with a woman over a disputed plot of land in the Periyavilan area.

title: ASP Wootler to address INTERPOL conference
byline: Police Spokesperson, Assistant Superintendent of Police (ASP) Fredrick Wootler, left for France this morning, following an invitation to attend the First Global Conference for Public Communication organised by the INTERPOL.

title: Eta Aquarids meteor shower to peak on May 6
byline: The annual Eta Aquarids meteor shower, one of the most anticipated celestial events of the year, is set to reach its peak on May 6, 2026, according to the Astronomy Division of the Arthur C Clarke Institute for Modern Technologies.

title: Sri Lanka calls fresh bids for Mattala Airport development
byline: The Airport and Aviation Services (Sri Lanka) (Private) Limited (AASL) said that Expressions of Interest (EOI) are now open for the development and operation of the Mattala Rajapaksa International Airport (MRIA). The invitation is extended to both local and international investors interested in participating in the future expansion and commercial use of the airport.

title: Mainly fair weather to prevail across island
byline: Mainly fair weather will prevail over most parts of the island, the Meteorology Department said.

title: Video: Moment Trump rushed from White House Correspondents’ Dinner after gunshots heard
byline: US President Donald Trump was rushed to safety from the White House Correspondents’ Dinner after gunshots rang out at the venue.

title: Monks nabbed  at BIA with over 110kg of narcotics
byline: A group of young monks pursuing higher education in various institutions across Sri Lanka has been apprehended at the Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA) in Katunayake for allegedly smuggling a large stock of narcotics into the country.

title: Trump evacuated from White House correspondents’ dinner after shots fired
byline: United States President Donald Trump was evacuated from the White House correspondents’ dinner in Washington, DC, after shots were fired outside the event.

title: AI in Higher Education: A shift that cannot be ignored?
byline: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is no longer a distant concept; it is already integrated into the daily lives of everyone, including students across Sri Lankan higher education institutions.

title: Iranian Ambassador links Minab tragedy with orphaned children in Colombo
byline: Iranian Ambassador Alireza Delkhosh brought together the memory of the Minab school tragedy with the lives of orphaned children in Sri Lanka, turning a simple gathering at the Fathima Orphanage into a moment of shared sorrow, empathy and solidarity.

title: Final rites of suspended Finance Ministry official today
byline: The final rites of Ranga Nishantha Rajapaksa, the suspended Assistant Director of the External Resources Department of the Ministry of Finance, are scheduled to take place this afternoon, May 2.

title: US withdrawing 5,000 troops from Germany, US officials say
byline: The United States is withdrawing 5,000 troops from NATO ally Germany, the Pentagon announced on Friday, as ​a rift over the Iran war widens between President Donald Trump and Europe.

title: Tourist arrivals top 850,000 despite dip in March, April
byline: Tourist arrivals to Sri Lanka have surpassed the 850,000 mark so far this year, despite a slowdown in recent months, said the Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority (SLTDA).

title: An influential figure behind the appointment of Eran as the Chief of SLC Transition Committee: Chamara
byline: There is an influential lady behind the appointment of Samagi Jana Balawegaya (SJB) Member Eran Wickremaratne as the Chairman of Sri Lanka Cricket (SLC) transitional committee, Sri Lanka Freedom Party (SLFP) National Organiser Chamara Sampath Dassanayake alleged yesterday.

title: Fire at Kalutara IRD Office under investigation
byline: Police have initiated an investigation into a fire that erupted at the Kalutara Regional Office of the Inland Revenue Department on Thursday (30) night.

title: 24-year imprisonment for sexually abusing 15-year-old boy
byline: A Dhamma school teacher who stood indicted with causing grave sexual abuse to a 15-year-old boy was found guilty and sentenced to 24 years’ rigorous imprisonment by Monaragala High Court Judge Dr. Damith Nalinda Hewawasam on Thursday (30).
